body.markdown_zh:
今天是我的生日！

所以，今天就来聊聊灵感诞生的那一刻。

你好，灵感

这是 FRISK 的电视广告。

大家看过吗？

真的是非常棒的广告。我很喜欢。

大家都是在什么地方想到点子的呢？

我呢……

电车　　30％

浴室　　25％

会议室　15％

床　　　10％

写邮件时　9％

散步时　　5％

上网冲浪　3％

飞机　　　2％

厕所　　　1％

机场　　　0％

没想到，点子还挺常在会议室里诞生的。

这大概就是只有在我们这种做东西的会议上才会有的情况吧。

那么！




<details class="gf-director-language"><summary>查看官方英文版</summary>

Today is my birthday!

And I would like to talk about

what kind of timing does an idea comes up.

“Hello, Idea”

This is a TV commercial of Frisk.

Have you seen it?

It’s very fine commercial and

I love it very much.

When you need ideas, where is the place

you get ideas?

Mine is…

In the train… 30%

In the bath tub… 25%

Meeting room… 15%

In the bed… 10%

While e-mailing… 9%

While walking… 5%

While net surfing… 3%

On the plane… 2%

In the bath roomﾂ… 1%

At the air port… 0%

Surprisingly enough, some ideas come up

while we’re having a meeting.

Since creation is our trade,

this kind of scene can be seen in Game Freak.


</details>
